name: night-red-roses-couple-selfie
image_purpose: Couple celebration post and event memory

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical romantic couple selfie of two approved adults celebrating indoors at night, using the supplied face references and preserving roses, heart balloons, flash, and party mood.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman in the foreground with long glossy dark-brown hair, warm brown eyes, bold classic red lipstick, glam evening makeup, fitted black dress, and chunky gold bracelet. Approved adult man beside her with short textured dark hair, tidy beard stubble, soft smile, and black button-up shirt. Preserve both supplied faces exactly.
prompt.composition_elements: Woman extends her arm to take the selfie; man leans close and smiles. Huge bouquet of vivid red roses wrapped in black paper dominates the foreground. Shiny red heart balloons, glass window, table with white cloth, and darker indoor background behind them. Vertical 2:3.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong direct smartphone flash creates crisp highlights on faces and flowers, subtle falloff into dark background, slight vignette, rich realistic color and mild low-light noise.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone front-camera selfie, 24-26mm equivalent wide lens, f/2, ISO 400, direct built-in flash, vertical 2:3, realistic skin texture and slight arm distortion.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 2:3 romantic selfie of two approved adults celebrating indoors at night, preserving both supplied face references. The adult woman is in the foreground with long glossy dark-brown hair, warm brown eyes, bold classic red lipstick, glam evening makeup, fitted black dress, and chunky gold bracelet; the adult man stands close beside her with short textured dark hair, tidy beard stubble, soft smile, and black button-up shirt. She extends her arm toward the smartphone camera while he leans in. Huge bouquet of vivid red roses wrapped in black paper fills the foreground; shiny red heart balloons, glass window, and white-tablecloth table behind them. Direct smartphone flash, crisp highlights, dark falloff, realistic skin, slight vignette and low-light noise, candid celebration mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, changed faces, distorted bouquet, extra fingers, warped hands, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, invented text

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve both adult identities, facial structure, outfit, pose, bouquet, balloons, environment, and lighting. People, wardrobe, flowers, and decor may be replaced only while retaining the same couple-celebration composition. Do not invent typography or logos.
